hackathon: Build Agents for the Real World V2

milestones.name: AI Liquidity Map
milestones.description: Interactive SVG-based liquidity visualization with real-time pool data, custom components (no Recharts conflicts), and agent-driven pool allocation display.

milestones.name: MiniPay UX + Mobile Optimization
milestones.description: Mobile-first UI optimized for MiniPay Opera Mini users with $1,200 avg balance. Sub-12s onboarding, 3-tap max interactions, offline-first architecture.

milestones.name: Yield Router + AMM Integrations
milestones.description: DeFi strategy router with Aave v3, Morpho, and Mento V3 integrations. Autonomous rebalancing based on APY signals and risk tolerance settings.

milestones.name: Card Infrastructure + PIX Off-ramp
milestones.description: Yield-backed virtual card with JIT liquidity and PIX off-ramp for Brazilian market. Transfero payout integration and Mento swap simulation.
